{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lllun''' were a [[Kian'thar]] political faction that tried to bring the Kian'thar people into the galactic community, and were constantly at odds with the [[Iith'lon]] faction. They were also known as the '''Progressives'''.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
